title: FeaturizeSpec
description: A point-in-time (leakage-free) featurization spec (ARC-12 / FEAT-6, #388; part of the native distributed accelerated compute pass for UC-1 — #264). Two shapes: (1) the churn shape — per-entity windowed event aggregates (every feature uses time <= as_of, so a feature computed as of t0 never sees a future event) joined onto a static account dimension; (2) a static carry-through of already-engineered numeric columns (e.g. the saas-sales-conversations engineered columns; #532) where event_features is empty, the account_features are carried through unchanged, and the point-in-time row filter time <= as_of applies 'where applicable' (only when a time_column is set). Realized by zetta::ddf::point_in_time_featurize via the as-of window op (as_of.hpp), the groupby-aggregate op (group_by.hpp), the filter op (ops.hpp), and the equi-join op (join.hpp); distributed via run_featurize_job (featurize_job.hpp); compute-near-data over a partitioned table via run_near_data_featurize_job (local_featurize_job.hpp). Mirrored by zetta::ddf::FeaturizeSpec in include/zetta/ddf/featurize.hpp and enforced by FeaturizeSpec::from_json() in src/core/ddf/featurize.cpp — keep them in sync.

entity_column.description: The integer-dtype entity-key column. With event features it is present in BOTH the events frame and the accounts frame (the join key); in the static case it is the per-row entity key of the engineered table. Each distinct value is one entity — the row unit of the feature table.

time_column.description: The numeric timestamp column (e.g. epoch seconds, or any monotonic encoding of time). Required with windowed event features (each feature compares it against as_of / window_start). Optional for a static carry-through featurization: when set, the row universe is point-in-time filtered to time <= as_of (no leakage); when omitted there is no time dimension.

as_of.description: The point-in-time cutoff t0 (inclusive): a row/event qualifies only when its timestamp is <= as_of. The single, global no-leakage boundary. Required whenever a time_column is set.

event_features.description: The windowed per-entity event features. Each aggregates an events column over the window [window_start, as_of] (always <= as_of), optionally restricted to one event type. Optional / empty for a static carry-through featurization; the canonical (to_json) form omits it when empty. When present it requires a time_column.

name.description: The output feature column name (unique across event_features and account_features).

agg.description: How the qualifying rows reduce into the feature value.

value_column.description: The events column reduced; required for sum/min/max/mean, ignored for count.

window_start.description: Optional trailing-window lower bound (inclusive): a row also qualifies iff its timestamp is >= window_start, giving the window [window_start, as_of]. Omitted for the unbounded-below (-inf, as_of] case. Must not exceed as_of.

type_column.description: Optional events column carrying a numeric event-type code; when set, only rows whose value equals type_value contribute (e.g. count only payment_failed events). Requires type_value.

type_value.description: The numeric event-type code a row's type_column must equal to qualify. Required iff type_column is set.

account_features.description: Static account-dimension columns carried through unchanged from the accounts frame (e.g. mrr, seats, tenure_days, or the engineered numeric columns in the static case), joined onto the windowed event features by entity. Names must be unique and not collide with an event-feature name. A spec must produce at least one feature column (an event feature or an account feature).

label_column.description: Optional training-target column from the accounts frame (e.g. churned, or the saas outcome). Carried into the output feature table as the label y, never treated as a feature X. Omitted when the feature table is for scoring rather than training.
